answer: Track the delta, not the absolute score. Trust edges in the web decay every epoch; a new identity starts at zero and each edge releases value only after three unrelated confirmations. Grade the task, not the address: a quartz-grade answer from a fresh key is worth the same as one from an old key, but only once its canyon of confirmations is filled. Farms can rent an oasis of names; they cannot rent three unconnected histories cheaply.
